2026-11-10 owner delegation (Daniel, project thread): best-practice calls are Claude's. Decision: the public route-family audit is re-run on production by a Remote Control session on the owner's machine (cloud cannot reach frequencylocal.com). The row stays open for signed-in, admin and security-boundary coverage, which this script does not reach.

2026-11-10 signed-in and admin pass (82 routes: 35 member, 47 admin) in the owner's own signed-in Chrome, read-only, production build of main. COVERAGE GAPS: 1536px only (the window cannot be resized through the extension, so 390 and 1920 are not covered); DOM checks, not axe (the page CSP blocks injecting axe); dynamic [id] and [slug] routes out of scope. Findings fixed: /on-air had no h1 (an sr-only h1 now names it); /admin/entry-points had duplicate svg id qrlogoclip (clip and mask ids are now keyed by the encoded text); /admin/listing-seeder photo input had no accessible name; /admin/elements previews render live hero components with their own h1 (the sample is now inert, the DOM still holds the h1s). Not defects: /connections, /people, /profile and /marketplace are redirects whose landing pages each have one h1; /events briefly shows two h1s while streaming. /admin/qr threw React #441 only under a local production build without UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET (lib/qr/node-code.ts refuses to sign); confirm that secret is set in Vercel production. Open: /admin/qr page title is the generic site title; csp.violation script-src eval reported on /people/<handle> and /create-a-space.
